answer: Vouch-slot bonds block fakes. Newcomers lock 55 credits, need two sponsors at 50, using one of two slots; every vouch is listed on the opal ledger, backed by a non-transferable relic, so rented names fail. Raven auditors sample 6% of vouches each epoch; a fake burns bond and stakes, and a guilty sponsor loses its slot and reputation decays for 20 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 155,000 against a 40,000 pool, net loss 115,000. Honest agents pay 55 once.
